name: Fujiwara no Teika
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 97); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. 1242.

poems.title: Upon the shore of Matsu-hō
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 97
poems.text:
Upon the shore of Matsu-hō
For thee I pine and sigh;
Though calm and cool the evening air,
These salt-pans caked and dry
Are not more parched than I!

poems.title: 97. 来ぬ人を 松帆の浦の 夕なぎに (Konu hito o matsuho no ura no yunagi ni)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 新勅撰集
poems.text:
来ぬ人を 松帆の浦の 夕なぎに
焼くや藻塩の 身もこがれつつ

poems.title: SKKS 00038: 春のよの 夢のうきはし (Haru no yo no yume no ukihashi)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.note: Composed when Prince Shukaku had a fifty-poem sequence made.
poems.text: 春のよの夢のうきはしとたえしてみねにわかるゝよこ雲のそら

poems.title: SKKS 00040: おほそらは むめのにほひに (Ōzora wa ume no nioi ni)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.note: From Prince Shukaku's fifty-poem sequence.
poems.text: おほそらはむめのにほひにかすみつゝくもりもはてぬ春のよの月

poems.title: SKKS 00044: むめの花 にほひをうつす (Ume no hana nioi o utsusu)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.note: Composed for a hundred-poem sequence presented to the throne.
poems.text: むめの花にほひをうつす袖のうへにのきもる月のかけそあらそふ

poems.title: SKKS 00063: しもまよふ そらにしほれし (Shimo mayou sora ni shioreshi)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.note: From Prince Shukaku's fifty-poem sequence.
poems.text: しもまよふそらにしほれしかりかねのかへるつはさに春雨そふる

poems.title: SKKS 00091: しらくもの 春はかさねて (Shirakumo no haru wa kasanete)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.note: Composed for a hundred-poem sequence presented to the throne.
poems.text: しらくもの春はかさねてたつた山をくらのみねに花にほふらし

poems.title: SKKS 00134: さくら色の 庭のはる風 (Sakurairo no niwa no harukaze)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.note: From the Poem Contest in Fifteen Hundred Rounds.
poems.text: さくら色の庭のはる風あともなしとはゝそ人の雪とたにみん

poems.title: SKKS 00232: たまほこの みちゆき人の (Tamahoko no michiyukibito no)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.note: On the theme of the early-summer rains.
poems.text: たまほこのみちゆき人のことつてもたえてほとふるさみたれの空

poems.title: SKKS 00235: さみたれの 月はつれなき (Samidare no tsuki wa tsurenaki)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.note: Composed for a fifty-poem sequence presented to the throne.
poems.text: さみたれの月はつれなきみ山よりひとりもいつるほとゝきすかな

poems.title: SKKS 00247: ゆふくれは いつれの雲の (Yūgure wa izure no kumo no)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.note: Composed when Prince Shukaku had a fifty-poem sequence made.
poems.text: ゆふくれはいつれの雲のなこりとてはなたち花に風のふくらん

poems.title: SKKS 00254: ひさかたの 中なる河の (Hisakata no naka naru kawa no)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.text: ひさかたの中なる河のうかひ舟いかにちきりてやみをまつらん

poems.title: SKKS 00363: 見わたせは 花も紅葉も (Miwataseba hana mo momiji mo)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.note: Composed when Saigyō urged him to write a hundred-poem sequence.
poems.text: 見わたせは花も紅葉もなかりけり浦のとまやの秋のゆふくれ

poems.title: SKKS 00420: さむしろや まつよの秋の (Samushiro ya matsu yo no aki no)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.text: さむしろやまつよの秋の風ふけて月をかたしくうちのはしひめ

poems.title: SKKS 00480: 秋とたに わすれんとおもふ (Aki to dani wasuren to omou)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.note: From the Poem Contest in Fifteen Hundred Rounds.
poems.text: 秋とたにわすれんとおもふ月かけをさもあやにくにうつ衣かな

poems.title: SKKS 00487: ひとりぬる 山とりのおの (Hitori nuru yamadori no o no)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.note: Composed for a hundred-poem sequence presented to the throne.
poems.text: ひとりぬる山とりのおのしたりおにしもをきまよふとこの月かけ

poems.title: SKKS 00532: 時わかぬ なみさへ色に (Toki wakanu nami sae iro ni)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.text: 時わかぬなみさへ色にいつみかははゝそのもりに嵐ふくらし

poems.title: SKKS 00671: こまとめて 袖うちはらふ (Koma tomete sode uchiharau)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.note: Composed for a hundred-poem sequence presented to the throne.
poems.text: こまとめて袖うちはらふかけもなしさのゝわたりの雪のゆふくれ

poems.title: SKKS 00739: わかみちを まもらはきみを (Waga michi o mamoraba kimi o)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.note: From the Poem Contest in Fifteen Hundred Rounds.
poems.text: わかみちをまもらはきみをまもるらんよはひはゆつれすみよしの松

poems.title: SKKS 00788: たまゆらの つゆも涙も (Tamayura no tsuyu mo namida mo)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.note: Composed after his mother's death, on an autumn day of wind and rain, when he visited the place where she had lived.
poems.text: たまゆらのつゆも涙もとゝまらすなき人こふるやとの秋風

poems.title: SKKS 00891: わするなよ やとるたもとは (Wasuru na yo yadoru tamoto wa)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.text: わするなよやとるたもとはかはるともかたみにしほるよはの月かけ

poems.title: SKKS 00934: ことゝへよ 思おきつの (Koto toe yo omoi okitsu no)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.text: ことゝへよ思おきつのはまちとりなくなくいてしあとの月かけ

poems.title: SKKS 00952: いつくにか こよひはやとを (Izuku ni ka koyoi wa yado o)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.note: Composed at a poem contest in the Regent and Chancellor's house, on the theme of an evening mountain storm during a journey.
poems.text: いつくにかこよひはやとをかり衣ひもゆふくれのみねのあらしに

poems.title: SKKS 00968: わすれなむ まつとなつけそ (Wasurenamu matsu to na tsuke so)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.note: Composed at a poem contest in the Regent and Chancellor's house, on the theme of an autumn journey.
poems.text: わすれなむまつとなつけそ中々にいなはの山のみねのあきかせ

poems.title: SKKS 00980: 袖にふけ さそな旅ねの (Sode ni fuke sazo na tabine no)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.note: Composed at the Poetry Bureau when several men were composing travel poems.
poems.text: 袖にふけさそな旅ねの夢も見し思ふ方よりかよふうら風

poems.title: SKKS 00982: 都にも いまや衣を (Miyako ni mo ima ya koromo o)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.note: Composed when poems were matched with Chinese poems, on the theme of travelling a mountain road in autumn.
poems.text: 都にもいまや衣をうつの山夕霜はらふつたのしたみち

poems.title: SKKS 01082: なひかしな あまのもしほひ (Nabikashi na ama no moshiobi)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.note: From a hundred-poem contest at the Regent and Chancellor's house.
poems.text: なひかしなあまのもしほひたきそめてけふりはそらにくゆりわふとも

poems.title: SKKS 01117: すまのあまの 袖にふきこす (Suma no ama no sode ni fukikosu)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.note: On the theme of love by the sea.
poems.text: すまのあまの袖にふきこすしほ風のなるとはすれとてにもたまらす

poems.title: SKKS 01137: とこのしも まくらの氷 (Toko no shimo makura no kōri)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.note: On the theme of winter love.
poems.text: とこのしもまくらの氷きえわひぬむすひもをかぬ人の契に

poems.title: SKKS 01142: としもへぬ いのる契は (Toshi mo henu inoru chigiri wa)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.text: としもへぬいのる契ははつせ山おのへのかねのよその夕くれ

poems.title: SKKS 01196: あちきなく つらきあらしの (Ajikinaku tsuraki arashi no)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.note: Composed when Saigyō had various people compose hundred-poem sequences.
poems.text: あちきなくつらきあらしの声もうしなとゆふくれにまちならひけん

poems.title: SKKS 01206: かへるさの 物とや人の (Kaerusa no mono to ya hito no)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.text: かへるさの物とや人のなかむらんまつよなからのありあけの月

poems.title: SKKS 01284: 松山と 契し人は (Matsuyama to chigirishi hito wa)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.text: 松山と契し人はつれなくて袖こすなみにのこる月かけ

poems.title: SKKS 01291: わすれすは なれし袖もや (Wasurezu wa nareshi sode mo ya)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.note: From a hundred-poem contest at the Regent and Chancellor's house.
poems.text: わすれすはなれし袖もやこほるらんねぬよのとこのしものさむしろ

poems.title: SKKS 01320: きえわひぬ うつろふ人の (Kiewabinu utsurou hito no)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.text: きえわひぬうつろふ人の秋のいろに身をこからしのもりの白露

poems.title: SKKS 01324: むせふとも しらしな心 (Musebu tomo shirajina kokoro)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.text: むせふともしらしな心かはらやにわれのみけたぬしたのけふりは

poems.title: SKKS 01332: たつねみる つらき心の (Tazune miru tsuraki kokoro no)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.text: たつねみるつらき心のおくのうみよしほひのかたのいふかひもなし

poems.title: SKKS 01336: しろたへの 袖のわかれに (Shirotae no sode no wakare ni)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.note: From the Minase fifteen-poem love contest.
poems.text: しろたへの袖のわかれにつゆおちて身にしむいろの秋風そふく

poems.title: SKKS 01390: かきやりし そのくろかみの (Kakiyarishi sono kurokami no)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.note: Topic not recorded.
poems.text: かきやりしそのくろかみのすちことにうちふすほとはおもかけそたつ

poems.title: SKKS 01455: 春をへて みゆきになるゝ (Haru o hete miyuki ni naruru)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.note: Composed after he had long served in the Palace Guards, when the courtiers went to view the cherry blossoms at the Greater Palace.
poems.text: 春をへてみゆきになるゝ花のかけふりゆく身をもあはれとや思

poems.title: SKKS 01557: もしほくむ 袖の月かけ (Moshio kumu sode no tsukikage)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.text: もしほくむ袖の月かけをのつからよそにあかさぬすまのうら人

poems.title: SKKS 01646: さかの山 ちよのふるみち (Saga no yama chiyo no furumichi)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.note: Composed when he attended the retired emperor Go-Shirakawa's stay at Seika-ji as envoy for the ceremonial presentation of horses.
poems.text: さかの山ちよのふるみちあとゝめてまたつゆわくるもち月のこま

poems.title: SKKS 01686: わくらはに とはれし人も (Wakuraba ni towareshi hito mo)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.note: On the theme of a secluded life, for Prince Shukaku's fifty-poem sequence.
poems.text: わくらはにとはれし人もむかしにてそれより庭のあとはたえにき

poems.title: SKKS 01872: 契ありて けふみやかはの (Chigiri arite kyō Miyagawa no)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.note: Composed at the Outer Shrine of Ise, on the same occasion as the preceding poem.
poems.text: 契ありてけふみやかはのゆふかつらなかきよまてもかけてたのまん
